title: What Are Programmatic Ads & How to Reach Your Target Effectively

facts.fact: The Telkomsel Enterprise blog post 'What Are Programmatic Ads & How to Reach Your Target Effectively' was published on 24 Dec 2024.
The Telkomsel Enterprise blog post 'What Are Programmatic Ads & How to Reach Your Target Effectively' was last updated on 25 Jun 2025.
The page defines programmatic advertising as the automated buying and selling of digital ad space.
facts.quote: At its core, programmatic advertising is the automated buying and selling of digital ad space.

facts.fact: The page states that programmatic display ads are automatically served across a network of sites such as Google Display Network.
facts.quote: programmatic display ads are automatically served across a network of sites like Google Display Network
